output.summary: The claim was denied because the member has not met the 12‑month continuous enrollment waiting period for maternity benefits. Until proof of the required enrollment period is provided, no appeal basis exists.

items.text: Provide documentation that shows the member was continuously enrolled for the required 12 months before the maternity service date.
Verify the enrollment record against the policy’s 12‑month waiting period requirement.
Because the waiting period was not met, the disposition is NO_BASIS_ESCALATE and there is no basis for an appeal.
